newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open mixed to lower, seeking direction.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open mixed to lower, seeking direction.

text.p: British shares opened mixed to lower on Monday and dealers said the market was expected to spend the day groping for direction, with no major results or data due and Wall Street shut for the Presidents' Day holiday.
"We'll be oscillating around where we closed on Friday," one dealer said.
By 0843 GMT the FTSE 100 share index was at 4,327.7, 13.3 points down from Friday's record close.
Sterling strength and political worries could continue to niggle the market, dealers said, but major moves were seen as unlikely in the absence of Wall Street.
